subject: Proposed slots + who to include for the technical review and security Q&A
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed windows for platform review and security Q&A

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side: NovaHealth is evaluating a hosted inference solution for clinical-notes summarization and triage routing. Key priorities you mentioned were predictable latency for 1–2k qps bursts, data isolation for PHI workloads, and an operational plan that keeps total cost-of-inference within your 10% budget target.

Next sensible step: a 60-minute technical review focused on integration patterns, performance expectations, and a short security Q&A for your team. To make scheduling simple, here are windows we have next week (PT):
- Tue 5/18: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 5/19: 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00

Can you confirm which slot works for your team and who from NovaHealth you want on the call (security, procurement, platform)? If helpful, I can prioritize the earlier slot on Tue and loop in our Security & Compliance engineer plus an SRE/solutions engineer.

Attached: tech-deep-dive-agenda.docx (draft), nova_security_questionnaire.pdf (stub), redwood-sla-and-pricing-quote.xlsx (preview).

Next steps I suggest:
1) You pick a preferred slot or propose alternatives.
2) Share the security contact and procurement lead to include on the invite.
3) If you have an NDA/procurement playbook, forward so we can align legal early.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on what you need on the agenda.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0186

From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed windows for platform review and security Q&A

Soojin —

Appreciate the summary. Tue 5/18 10:00–11:00 PT works best for our team. I’m looping in Amit Shah (security) and our procurement mailbox so they can confirm availability and share any intake docs.

Amit Shah <amit.shah@novahealth.com> (cc) — can you join for the security Q&A? Procurement, please confirm if we need a separate procurement pre-call.

Also: can you provide a short list of SOC2 artifacts and the expected data flow diagram before the call? That will help our security team triage pre-reads.

Thanks,
Samantha Reed
Director of Platform Partnerships | NovaHealth
samantha.reed@novahealth.com

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Tue 5/18 10:00 PT — tech review + security Q&A (calendar invite forthcoming)

Thanks for the quick reply, Samantha — confirmed for Tue 5/18 10:00–11:00 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute.

Looping in our internal leads so you have points of contact on the call:
- Neha Kapoor — Security & Compliance (neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com)
- Sergio Alvarez — Solutions / SRE (sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com)
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineering (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com) — she’ll run the integration portion.

Neha: Samantha asked for SOC2 artifacts and the data flow diagram pre-read. Short list of items that would be useful to share before the meeting:
- SOC 2 Type II summary report (redacted)
- Data flow diagram (how PHI would be handled/ingested, any transient storage)
- encryption/KMS outline and key rotation policy summary
- retention & deletion slides (how we handle patient data at rest/in transit)

If possible, can you drop the pre-reads into the Drive folder I linked below before 9:30 PT tomorrow so the NovaHealth folks can review? I’ve also attached the agenda and a short pricing preview so procurement can see ballpark numbers ahead of the call.

Drive pre-reads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Samantha/procurement: if you have standard contract language or an intake form, please send it along and we’ll have our legal/finance review ready to speak to options (reserved vs hosted).

Thanks — invite coming shortly.

—
Soojin

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@novahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Confirmed: Tue 5/18 10:00 PT — tech review + security Q&A

Hi all —

Thanks for the loop. Quick note on pre-reads and scope for the Q&A:

I uploaded the following to the Drive link Soojin shared:
- redwood-security-brief.pdf (stub) — high-level SOC2 summary and controls mapping
- data-flow-diagram.png — redacted flow for hosted inference with PHI
- encryption-and-kms-summary.docx — KMS options and rotation cadence

For tomorrow’s call I’ll be prepared to:
- Walk through the data flow and where PHI may be present in transit vs ephemeral cache
- Confirm our SOC2 coverage relevant to NovaHealth’s control families (CC6/CC7 equivalents)
- Discuss customer-managed keys and on-prem/private deployment options

If the procurement team wants an initial cost estimate for a 12-month committed Dedicated lane vs hosted usage, Sergio can cover that in 10–15 minutes of the call.

If you need anything else pre-call, ping me here — otherwise we’ll see you at 10:00 PT.

—
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference
